desc:
Pick your fighter and battle in fast, pixel-art 2D combat! Chain combos, charge your ki, transform mid-fight and finish with a cinematic Ultimate.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS
Move / Jump: W A S D
Light: U
Medium: I
Heavy: O
Special: J
Ultimate: K
Guard: L
Dash: Space
Charge Ki: H
Dragon Rush: E
Transform: T
Pause: P

• 40+ fighters to unlock
• Fight the CPU or climb the ELO ranks online
• Top the global ELO and Wins leaderboards
• Open booster packs to find new fighters
• New? The built-in tutorial teaches you everything

Special moves: hold a direction + J, or Q + J
Full move list: Pause > List of Movements

Also playable on phone, tablet and controller!

Press PLAY and prove you're the strongest!
